description: Figure 6 is a pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" that illustrates the breakdown of token resolution methods. The chart is divided into three segments: a large green segment labeled "LOCAL" which accounts for 94.5% of the tokens, a small red segment labeled "LLM" representing 3.9%, and a small blue segment labeled "EDGE_P2P" accounting for 1.6%. The chart visually emphasizes that the vast majority of token resolution occurs locally, with a much smaller proportion being resolved through the cloud-based LLM and an even smaller portion via peer-to-peer (P2P) exchange.
